tasks.title: Buy fruit at a market
tasks.objective: Separate count, weight and total price and ask for clarification in a short purchase.
tasks.context:
— Bonjour. Je voudrais deux pommes et un kilo de tomates, s’il vous plaît.
— Les pommes rouges ou les vertes ?
— Les rouges. Combien ça coûte ?
— Cinq euros en tout.
— Voilà. Merci et bonne journée !

Understand: Je voudrais is a useful polite request learned as a chunk here. Deux pommes counts items; un kilo de tomates gives a measured quantity. Les rouges refers back to les pommes. En tout introduces the total, not a price per kilo.

Language: After a measured quantity use de: un kilo de tomates. In les rouges, the adjective agrees with the understood plural feminine pommes.

tasks.title: Transfer and review: Buy fruit at a market
tasks.objective: Separate count, weight and total price and ask for clarification in a short purchase.
tasks.context:
Write 35–50 French words as a market dialogue. Request two familiar items, specify one quantity and ask the total. Invent a consistent price. Include a greeting and thanks; check de after kilo. Then perform both roles aloud.

Speaking transfer: Ask the Tutor to sell fruit and offer two colours. State a quantity, choose one and ask the price; request repetition once.

Revision: Recall the quantity without looking, then vary only the number. Review saved spelling mistakes before repeating.
